info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, Ypos, smokeState, rotWise, Yvelglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gSmokeListon beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  Xpos = float(-1000)  Ypos = float(-1000)  Yvel = -2  smokeState = #NULL  this.locZ = 105  gSmokeList.add(this)  rotWise = random(2)  if rotWise = 2 then    rotWise = -1  end ifendon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case smokeState of      #NULL:        Xpos = -1000        Ypos = -1000        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        rand = random(10)        this.width = rand        this.height = rand        this.blend = 100      #SMOKE:        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset        Ypos = Ypos + Yvel        this.rotation = this.rotation + (rotWise * 3)        if this.width < 50 then          this.width = this.width + 2          this.height = this.height + 2        else          this.width = this.width + 2          this.height = this.height + 2        end if        this.blend = this.blend - 2        if this.blend = 0 then          smokeState = #NULL          gSmokeList.add(this)          Xpos = -1000          Ypos = -1000          this.width = 1          this.height = 1          this.blend = 100        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos    end case  end ifend
info.name: Smoke
